groups.description: The Playwright Test Builder enables users to create browser automation tests using Playwright. These tests serve as powerful verification steps in workflows, allowing AI-driven automation to validate that web applications behave correctly after changes. Users write TypeScript/JavaScript test code, run tests, and view results including failure screenshots.
